test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A right circular cylindrical tunnel of diameter 2 m and length 40 m is to be constructed from a sheet of iron. The area of the iron sheet required in m², is:
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the cylindrical tunnel = 2 m

Radius of the cylindrical tunnel = 2/2 = 1 m

Length (height) of the tunnel = 40 m

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area = 2π × 1 × 40 = 80π

**∴ The area of the iron sheet required is 80π m².**
